Issuer: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority (EIOPA)
Summary: EIOPA is consulting on a draft Supervisory Statement to promote consistent, proportionate and risk-based supervision of IBIP sales processes and pre-contractual disclosures without introducing new regulatory requirements or prescribed supervisory methods.
title: Consultation on the draft Supervisory Statement on IBIP Sales Processes

Summary: The EBA’s final report proposes amendments to the prudential standards for central securities depositories and designated credit institutions, addressing risks arising when banking CSDs provide banking-type ancillary services to participants of other CSDs and updating references to reflect changes in EU legislation.
title: Regulatory Technical Standards on prudential requirements for central securities depositories (CSDs) designated credit institutions offering ‘banking-type ancillary services’

Summary: ESMA’s final report sets out regulatory technical standards specifying requirements for post-trade risk reduction services and exercises to qualify for the clearing obligation exemption under EMIR.
title: Final report on the Regulatory Standards on the requirements for Post-Trade Risk Reduction services for the purpose of the clearing obligation exemption under EMIR

Summary: ESMA’s final report presents revised CSDR guidelines to standardise procedures and messaging protocols between investment firms and professional clients, including requirements for electronic communications and international open standards.
title: Final report on the revised CSDR Guidelines on standardised procedures and messaging protocols used between investment firms and their professional clients

Summary: The report presents ESMA’s final guidelines specifying when a supplement to a base prospectus is considered to introduce a new type of security, aiming to promote consistent supervision and investor protection across the EU.
title: Final Report on the Guidelines on supplements which introduce new securities to a base prospectus

Issuer: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority (EIOPA)
Summary: The report identifies extreme heat as the leading climate-related liability risk for life and health insurers and occupational pension providers, noting that current financial impacts are limited but risks are expected to increase in coming decades.
title: EIOPA Report on the impacts of climate change on life and health and potential emerging risks for the insurance and IORP sectors

Summary: The final report revises the EBA’s internal governance guidelines to reflect evolving risks and changes in EU law, clarifying management-body responsibilities, role mapping and governance requirements for third-country branches while applying proportionality.
title: Final report on Guidelines on internal governance

Issuer: Comissão do Mercado de Valores Mobiliários (CMVM)
Summary: The CMVM circular sets out supervisory expectations for venture capital alternative investment fund managers on prudential requirements and marketing practices, including investment and risk management, investment eligibility and limits, investor information and suitability, third-party referrals, and costs and charges.
title: Circular 007/2026 - Gestão de Ativos - Deveres em matéria de requisitos prudenciais e práticas de comercialização para os organismos de investimento alternativo de capital de risco

Summary: ESMA consults on draft regulatory and implementing technical standards specifying the scope, content, consolidation level and format of reporting on clearing activity at recognised third-country CCPs under EMIR Article 7d.
title: Consultation on the reporting framework under EMIR for clearing activity at recognised third-country CCPs

Issuer: Autoridade de Supervisão de Seguros e Fundos de Pensões (ASF)
Summary: ASF is consulting on a draft regulation setting quarterly capital-adjustment indices for fire and natural-elements insurance policies starting or renewing in the first quarter of 2027.
title: Consulta Pública n.º 6/2026 Projeto de Norma Regulamentar que estabelece os índices trimestrais de atualização de capitais para as apólices do ramo "Incêndio e elementos da natureza" com início ou vencimento no primeiro trimestre de 2027
